items.title: Wells Fargo customers double their BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings to $2.35B
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Wells Fargo's (WFC) reported holdings in BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), which doubled quarter over quarter to $2.35 billion as of June 30. With the bank's reported share count climbing 103%, Melker examines what the increase could signal about institutional demand for bitcoin (BTC-USD).

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: What Does Wells Fargo (WFC) Outage Trouble Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) reported technical outages that disrupted online and mobile banking access for customers in recent days. The glitches coincided with similar disruptions at several other major U.S. banks, pointing to a shared technology or network issue. Wells Fargo has not yet identified or disclosed a definitive root cause for the incident, and some services remain under close monitoring. items.title: Wells Fargo: Get Paid to Wait: or Buy at a Discount
items.summary: Selling cash secured puts on stocks an investor is happy to take ownership of is a great way to generate some extra income. A cash-secured put involves writing an at-the-money or out-of-the-money put option and simultaneously setting aside enough cash to buy the stock.
